fragments.text: Hello, my name is Josevena de Feragio, I'm a professor of Technical University of Valencia and I've been doing research on AI for quite a long time, but apart from that, I'm also teaching courses with my students at the university. And I'm going to talk a little bit about some ideas, remarks about exactly this use of AI in education and especially in evaluation. So there's a lot of discussion about AI and education and of course a lot of discussion about AI and work and of course these two things are related because education serves more than just preparing people for work, preparing people for life and to understand the world. But in with the user new tools coming from AI, things are changing very quickly and I'm going just to mention some ideas from my own experience as a researcher and also as a lecturer.
